aka: A White Warrior in a Black Suit
trans_title: A White Warrior in a Black Suit
introduction: The film, a double portrait of Ivan Kramberger, the father and son of the same name, is presented as a research dossier. The film looks into the influence and role of Ivan Kramberger Sr., the most controversial Slovenian politician, when Slovenia was gaining its independence. The camera is used to support his son's investigation of his father's political life. In the process, he uses interviews and looks at the extensive archive material. He speaks to the Slovenian »fathers of independence«, the politicians of the first Slovenian government from 1990 to 1992, historians, reporters, his father's co-workers, companions, and his family. On 7th June 1992, his father's life ended in the first political assassination in independent Slovenia; his son was six at the time. It is the story told by the son searching for the truth about his father.
